title: Almost everywhere divergence of Cesaro means of subsequences of Walsh--Paley Fourier partial sums
summary: We prove an almost everywhere divergence theorem for Cesàro means of subsequences of partial sums of Walsh--Fourier series. More precisely, we show that there exists a strictly increasing sequence of positive integers $(a_n)$ and a function $f\in L^1(G)$, where $G$ denotes the dyadic group, such that \[ \left( \frac1N\sum_{n=1}^N S_{a_n}f(x) \right)_{N=1}^{\infty} \] does not converge for almost every $x\in G$.
